name: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
description: Set during the High Republic era and the prime of the Jedi Order, follow Jedi younglings as they study the ways of the Force, explore the galaxy, help citizens and creatures in need, and learn valuable skills needed to become Jedi along the way.

videos.title: Meet the Young Jedi
videos.overview: Kai, Lys, and Nubs work together to battle a training droid at the Jedi Temple on Tenoo.

videos.title: Lys' Creature Caper
videos.overview: Lys follows the clues to retrieve an adorable creature running amok through the Jedi Temple.

videos.title: Kai's Daring Droid Rescue
videos.overview: When her droid RJ-83 is in trouble, Nash calls on Kai to help rescue him.

videos.title: Nubs and the Flower Fiasco
videos.overview: While on a mission to get a special flower, nature-lover Nubs uses some high-flying heroics to avoid a creature who also wants it.

videos.title: Nash's Firehawk Frenzy
videos.overview: Aboard Nash’s starship, The Crimson Firehawk, the young Jedi must evade Taborr’s ship.

videos.title: Taborr's Pirate Showdown
videos.overview: hen Taborr and his band of pirates pillage the Kublop Springs marketplace, Kai, Lys, and Nubs spring into action to stop them.

videos.title: Firehawk Rescue
videos.overview: The Jedi must stop pirates from stealing a ship.

videos.title: Skyring Soaring
videos.overview: Kai flies through a challenging obstacle course.

videos.title: A Droid's Mission
videos.overview: Droids RJ-83 and R0-M1 team up to find a rare part.

videos.title: Younglings in the Wild
videos.overview: Lys leads younglings on a wilderness adventure.

videos.title: Junkyard Joust
videos.overview: Kai and Taborr face off in Marlaa’s junkyard.

videos.title: Nubs-tacle Course
videos.overview: Nubs tries to stay calm during a training exercise.

videos.title: The Young Jedi / Yoda's Mission
videos.overview: Jedi younglings Kai, Lys, and Nubs go on their first adventure. Yoda gives the younglings a mission.

videos.title: Nash's Race Day / The Lost Jedi Ship
videos.overview: Nash's Jedi friends help her compete in a race. The young Jedi find a long-lost Jedi ship.

videos.title: Get Well Nubs / The Junk Giant
videos.overview: Kai and Lys seek out a cure for Nubs' illness. The young Jedi set out to catch a thief.

videos.title: Lys and the Snowy Mountain Rescue / Attack of the Training Droids
videos.overview: The younglings help wrangle creatures. Kai causes problems when he attempts to program droids to clean the temple.

videos.title: The Jellyfruit Pursuit / Creature Safari
videos.overview: Nash and the young Jedi pursue stolen jellyfruit. The younglings discover a bird-like creature.

videos.title: Squadron / Forest Defenders
videos.overview: The Jedi put their flying skills to the test. Kai and friends defend the forest creatures' homes.

videos.title: The Jedi and the Thief / The Missing Kibbin
videos.overview: Kai and Master Zia must get back her stolen ship. The young Jedi help a bounty hunter find a lost pet.

videos.title: The Girl and Her Gargantua / The Show Must Go On
videos.overview: The younglings track an escaped creature. Nash's Jedi friends help reunite her favorite band.

videos.title: The Princess and the Jedi / Kai's Bad Day
videos.overview: Nash and the young Jedi transport a princess. Kai's bad day worsens when a simple mission goes awry.

videos.title: Visitor's Day / The Growing Green Danger
videos.overview: Jedi track down artifacts stolen from the town fair. Nubs plants a seed that grows out of control.

videos.title: The Ganguls / Bad Eggs
videos.overview: Nash's Jedi friends set out to find her missing speeder. Hap's kitchen is overrun by creatures.

videos.title: Off the Rails / The Thieves of Tharnaka
videos.overview: Kai and the Jedi must stop Taborr's train heist. The Jedi set out to recover a mysterious artifact.

videos.title: Tree Troubles / Big Brother's Bounty
videos.overview: Nubs and the Jedi protect his favorite tree. The Jedi help a young bounty hunter find her brother.

videos.title: Charhound Chase / Creature Comforts
videos.overview: Kai helps Bell find his runaway charhound. Lys gets attached to a lost wild creature.

videos.title: An Adventure with Yoda / The Talon Takeover
videos.overview: Yoda teams up with the young Jedi to stop pirates. The Jedi must rescue Taborr from the Ganguls.

videos.title: Mystery of the Opal Cave / Clash
videos.overview: The young Jedi investigate a haunted cave. Kai and rival Jedi Djovi team up for a mission.

videos.title: Stuck in the Muck / Junkyard Sleepover
videos.overview: The Jedi respond to a distress call. The younglings investigate odd noises in the junkyard.

videos.title: The Great Leaf Glide / The Harvest Feast
videos.overview: The young Jedi learn how to sky surf. Kai and his friends help a family unite for a feast.

videos.title: Life Day / Raxlo Strikes Back
videos.overview: The Jedi help a Wookiee prepare for Life Day. The younglings protect wellagrin eggs from Raxlo.

videos.title: Aftershock / Feather Frenzy
videos.overview: Jedi help a prince. Creatures take over Nash's garage.

videos.title: Best Friends / Happy Trails, Nubs
videos.overview: Kai and Nubs team up. Nubs is captured by the Ganguls.

videos.title: The Tale of Short Spire / The Team Up
videos.overview: Jedi help on Batuu. Taborr and the Jedi work together.

videos.title: The Caves of Batuu / Finders Keepers
videos.overview: Kai explores a mystic cave. The Jedi help a scrapper.

videos.title: The Starship Show / Nash's Super Busy Day
videos.overview: Draiven steals a ship. Kai offers to help a busy Nash.

videos.title: The Prince and the Pirate
videos.overview: The Jedi must stop Taborr's plans on Starlight Beacon.

videos.title: Heroes and Hotshots / A Jedi or a Pirate
videos.overview: A new Padawan arrives on Tenoo. Kai helps a youngling.

videos.title: The Rustler Roundup / A New Discovery
videos.overview: Kai rounds up nerfs. Lys tracks a rare creature.

videos.title: A Pirate's Pet / The Secret Ship
videos.overview: Taborr traps a creature. Nash flies in Inaya's ship.

videos.title: Nubs's Big Mistake / The Jedi Rescue
videos.overview: Yoda joins Nubs on a mission. Wes is captured.

videos.title: The Terror of Tenoo / The Prince of Masks
videos.overview: A pirate ship is discovered. Cyrus' village needs help.

videos.title: Battle for the Band / Uprooted
videos.overview: Hap joins a Jedi mission. Nubs searches for a plant.

videos.title: Mine and Ours / The Andraven Circuit
videos.overview: The Jedi save a party. A Jedi friend needs help.

videos.title: The Great Gomgourd Quest / A Sticky Situation
videos.overview: Nubs recovers a stolen harvest. Kai must face a fear.

videos.title: The Missing Life Day Feast / The Lost Treasure of Tenoo
videos.overview: The Jedi save Life Day. Kai and Djovi face Blackbolt.

videos.title: The Wild Aklyrr / Lys' Lost Lightsaber
videos.overview: The Jedi help their friend. Lys' lightsaber is stolen.

videos.title: Tower Run / The Jumping Jetpack
videos.overview: The Jedi escape Yarrum Tower. Maz Kanata visits Tenoo.

videos.title: Unmasked
videos.overview: The Jedi help Cyrus defend his home against pirates.

videos.title: Just Like Wes / Raxlo to the Rescue
videos.overview: Pirates disrupt a mission. Raxlo’s harvester is taken.

videos.title: The Helpful Harvester / Little Lost Droid
videos.overview: Raxlo helps with a rescue. The Jedi look for a droid.

videos.title: Tenoo's Fastest / Home Sweet Temple
videos.overview: Nash helps a racer. Kai must team up with a thief.

videos.title: The Firehawk Feud / The Chop Shop Calamity
videos.overview: Lys helps a foe. Nash and the droids recover a part.

videos.title: Big Pooba Problems / Best Bounty Buddies
videos.overview: Nubs meets an adult Pooba. Bounty hunters team up.

videos.title: The Rainy Day Beast / Upgraded
videos.overview: The Jedi search for a creature. Kai must stop a thief.

videos.title: Journey to the Bracca Badlands / The Search for the Missing Dunnels
videos.overview: Jedi aid in a search. Lys wrangles escaped creatures.

videos.title: The Spaceport Setback / The Mission Mixup
videos.overview: Kai’s calm day goes awry. The Jedi have two missions.

videos.title: Yoda Rescue / Fossil Hunt
videos.overview: The young Jedi rescue Yoda. Kai protects a fossil.

videos.title: A Mission to Remember / The Bounty Hunter and the Thief
videos.overview: The Jedi help a droid. An odd partnership is formed.

videos.title: The Battle of Tenoo
videos.overview: When pirates invade Tenoo, the Jedi fight back.

videos.title: The New Droid Friends / Batuu Bonanza
videos.overview: The Jedi recover a stolen part from a troublemaking droidsmith; Kai loses a package on Batuu.

videos.title: Music Mayhem / The Night Lights of Tenoo
videos.overview: The Jedi save a concert from a troublemaking Rek; a camping trip to see nightlights goes awry.

videos.title: Journey to the Bottom of Naboo / Speeder Surprise
videos.overview: The Jedi go underwater to recover a lost artifact. Kai helps a cub get back to his family.

videos.title: Scrapping for a Song / Bell and the Band
videos.overview: The Jedi help Nash find her mom a birthday gift; Bell and Kai use music to save pets.

videos.title: To Do Good / Nubs and the Bumbling Bandits
videos.overview: Captured by Rek, Taborr asks the Jedi for help; Nubs chases bandits who stole from their ship.

videos.title: Apexx Awakens / Harvester Madness
videos.overview: Rek builds a new droid to stop the Jedi. Raxlo's old harvester falls into the hands of a foe.

videos.title: Making Friends
videos.overview: When their festival is threatened, the Jedi team up with Rek to stop Apexx and his droid army.
